## What it is

Stand-in for the combined board (`pcb/combined/combined.kicad_pcb`), used to
design boitier_ac and boitier_dc around it: the exact board outline, 1.6 mm
thick, the six M2 mounting holes, and the components that take height as
four-walled boxes standing on the top face.

## Design notes

- The south-west corner of the board is at the origin and north is up (KiCad's
  Y is flipped). Every position is kept in KiCad millimetres in the tables at
  the top of the file, so they can be checked against the board directly. If
  the board changes, update `_BOARD_OUTLINE_KICAD`, `_HOLES_KICAD`,
  `_COMPONENTS_KICAD` and `_XIAO_KICAD`.
- Holes H1–H6: 2.2 mm diameter (M2), through the board.
- Component boxes come from the 3D models placed as on the board, not from the
  footprint outlines (the LCSC HT396 outlines are drawn too large), and match
  the drawings in `docs/jlcpcb` (Kefa HT396V/R, JST XH). Heights above the top
  face: XH J1, J9, J10 7.0 mm; HT396V J6, J7, J8 10.1 mm; HT396R J2, J3 7.4 mm
  (the drawing; the LCSC model gives 7.5). With the XH plug in, the mated
  height is 9.8 mm (JST); the boxes show the bare headers.
- J2 and J3 sit at KiCad X 171.1 so their front face is flush with the east
  board edge (pins 9.6 mm behind the face on the Kefa drawing). Their mating plugs are not modelled: the HT396R plugs stick
  out east, past the board edge.
- XIAO: one box 15 mm above the board's underside, board included (1.6 mm PCB
  + 5 mm socket + 8.5 mm XIAO), 17.8 mm wide across the pin rows and 22.5 mm
  long: 21 mm of XIAO board plus the 1.5 mm USB-C overhang to the south.
- `component_wall` = 1.0 mm, the thinnest wall the printer lays reliably.

## Don't

- No other components: they add nothing to the enclosure design.
- No more `wall_around`: the plate used to grow the outline by the 1.68 mm
  enclosure wall; it is now the board itself.
- No polish pass: David wants sharp edges on this stand-in.
